newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Tele2000 to up capital $13.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Tele2000 to up capital $13.2 mln.

text.p: Peru's telecom Tele2000, controlled by U.S. BellSouth Corp plans to increase its capital by 35 million soles ($13.2 million) to 171.8 million soles, the Lima bolsa said Friday.
The country's second largest telecom, which had been mulling a capital increase of $50 million, will make the increase by mid-August, the Lima Stock Exchange said in its daily report.
In January, BellSouth bought a 59 percent stake in the company for $112.2 million.
Tele2000 competes with Peru's flagship company Telefonica del Peru to provide cellular telephone and cable television services in the country.
